messages:
Priya: quick update from the hotpath roadtrip — batching/KV sprint status. hitting throughput targets for 80-token workloads but seeing sporadic p99 spikes (~2% of requests) on tail. sharing samples & plan below.

Mateo: can you paste the sample request ids and the metric numbers?

Priya: samples: req-42f9, req-9a8c, req-dc1e. metric snapshot from the canary run: p50=12ms p95=42ms p99=180ms (on test-staging nodes). repro locally when microbatch_size <= 4.

Priya: repro command (local):
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood/internal/run -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"req_id":"req-42f9","seq_len":80,"microbatch":2}'
```

Jing: looks like KV miss spikes. are prefetch heuristics firing? which commit toggled this?

Priya: commit 6f2b3d4 (kernel/kv: enable-prefetch-adaptive). we lowered the prefetch threshold to 0.15 last night to try to cut cold misses.

Sam: I pushed a quick revert candidate that restores threshold to 0.3 and adds a runtime override. PR #3124.

Mateo: left a comment on the PR — prefer feature-flagging with a runtime override instead of hard revert. also we should canary-pin a dedicated pool to the older kernel config before full rollout.

Priya: agreed. plan: canary on dedicated pool "warm-2" at 10% traffic, sample p99 traces. tagging infra: @Sam @Jing for routing + fallback config.

deploy-bot: Canary created: canary/roadtrip-warm-2 -> 10% traffic. started 2026-03-17T22:04:00Z

Sam: infra note — routing rule uses tag 'canary:roadtrip-2026-03-17'. we should add explicit fallback to model-variant bfloat16-2 to avoid a mixed-precision regression.

Jing: instrumented prefix-cache hit rate. before the revert-candidate: 0.81, after candidate: 0.92. interestingly tail latency still shows isolated spikes. uploaded flamegraphs and trace samples: https://perf.redwood/roadtrip/6312345678

Priya: next steps: (1) let canary run 1h and collect p99 traces, (2) if p99 drops >= 25% promote; if not rollback. i'll post a summary after 1h. :hourglass_flowing_sand:  

Mateo: i'll queue regression tests for seq lengths [8, 16, 512] across xformers kernel variants and attach results to the PR.

Priya: anything blocking QA or rollout?

Jing: nothing blocking from infra/metrics side. i'll watch flamegraphs and KV metrics and flag anomalies.

Sam: if canary looks stable, i'll schedule a controlled rollout to the dedicated pools tomorrow 09:00 PST.

Priya: great — thanks all. updating the sprint board (roadtrip lane) now: https://board.redwood/sprints/roadtrip-23

Priya: will report back with p99 summary in ~1h. :eyes:
